newsitem.title: USA: Factory Card to open 30-35 stores in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Factory Card to open 30-35 stores in FY97.

text.p: Factory Card Outlet Corp said Tuesday it expects to open 30-35 superstores in its current fiscal year ending June 28.
It currently operates 125 stores in 15 states primarily in the Midwest and mid-Atlantic regions of the United States.

Earlier Tuesday, the company reported earnings for its fiscal second quarter ended December 28 rose 86.5 percent from the same period a year ago to $478,445 or $0.09 a share. This year's second quarter results include a charge of $312,886 or $0.06 per share from the early retirement of some debt. Second quarter sales rose 50.2 percent to $37.7 million.
Results benefited from expanded offerings of party supplies in all stores and an advertising focus on targeted direct mail, the company said in a statement.

Factory Card, which completed its initial public offering in mid-December, opened 12 superstores in its second quarter for a total of 17 superstores opened through the first two quarters of the current fiscal year.
The company-owned stores sell party supplies, greeting cards, and gift wrap.
Shares of Factory Card Outlet were trading off 1/4 to 10-1/2.
